source.test: loadSlots(forServerDir:) missing-directory guard combined with worldFolderNames(for:) returning empty — see docs/msc2/worlds/phase6-scope.md §"Why this is a real problem, not a hypothetical one"

notes: Neither source of world data exists: no live world/world_nether/world_the_end (or Bedrock worlds/) folders, and no world_slots/ directory. This is the state a raw-imported plain external install that was never started, or an MSC-1-managed server imported before its first stop (world_slots/ is only created lazily after first stop, per createInitialWorldSlotIfNeeded), can legitimately be in. Reconciliation has nothing to inventory and nothing to protect, so it is a complete no-op -- creating an empty slot or an active marker with nothing behind it would misrepresent a server that genuinely has no world yet as already having one.
